title: Someone paid $6.2M for a banana. Then ate it 🍌 #shorts
description: The fruit itself came from a New York street stand for about 35 cents. What the buyer really owns is a certificate and instructions for replacing the banana. Read more: NPR, Bloomberg, Smithsonian Magazine, The Art Newspaper.

scenes.say: Someone paid six point two million dollars for a banana.
It's an artwork called Comedian. One banana, one strip of duct tape, stuck to a wall.

scenes.label: Sotheby's, 2024
scenes.say: In November twenty twenty four, it sold at Sotheby's in New York to crypto founder Justin Sun.

scenes.label: the actual banana
scenes.say: The banana on display? Bought from a Manhattan fruit stand for about thirty five cents.
The buyer gets a certificate and instructions, so the banana can be swapped when it rots.
Nine days later, at an event in Hong Kong, he peeled it and ate it.
So is this art, or the most expensive joke ever?
